_meta.purpose: Office-led scenarios for the ground and first floor of B01 (Marievik 27). The use catalogue (data/catalogue) says which spaces each use must have and which rules apply; this file only adds what the catalogue cannot: the building, and the design choices that make one office different from another. Run: python -m engine.pilot data/pilots/marievik/b01.json
_meta.status: WORKING — geometry from OpenStreetMap, design assumptions are labelled. Replace both with drawings and AMF input.

building.name: Marievik 27 — vaulted-roof office (the study building)
building.plate_source: ESTIMATE: OpenStreetMap footprint, as in runs/grasshopper/B01.json (2312.6 m² footprint); verify against drawings

core.source: ESTIMATE: core size from parametric/mvk/use_profiles.json (office_open); two stairs assumed from data/building/marievik_shell.json escape_routes = 2. Real core count and position UNKNOWN.

assumptions._note: Design assumptions, not regulations. Each is used only where the catalogue has no size (strength 'none'). Change them here; every result shows which ones it used.

facade_zone_depth_m.source: practice: useful daylight reaches roughly 2-2.5 x window head height (2.9 m in use_profiles.json); AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 25 § requires daylight and view for permanent workplaces but sets no depth

desk_m2_in_facade_zone.source: practice: desk plus local circulation in an open plan

cell_room_facade_m.source: practice: one-person cellular room on a 1.35 m window module (use_profiles.json window_module) x 2

retail_m2_per_visitor.source: PLACEHOLDER: no source. Shoppers actually present at peak, far below the 0.5 persons/m² fire-design density (retail_shop.json), which is still used for the fire class

restaurant_m2_per_seat.source: practice: no Swedish source (restaurant_cafe.json rest_dining size strength 'none')

event_m2_per_person.source: practice: banquet layout; the legal default is 0.4 m²/person (assembly_event.json), which is the fire-design maximum

suite_corridor_m.source: practice: corridor clear width serving several tenancies (passage 0.90/1.20 m minimum, fire_egress_dimensions)

scenarios.label: A: Today
scenarios.story: Baseline: retail at street level, one tenant in cellular offices above.

scenarios.label: B: Open and efficient
scenarios.story: Public lobby and café at street level; activity-based office for one large tenant above.

scenarios.label: C: Small and flexible
scenarios.story: Coworking and shared reception at street level; 6 small suites with shared meeting rooms in the dark middle above.

cards.system: short, flexible leases; tenants can grow into a bigger suite

scenarios.label: D: Premium
scenarios.story: Hospitality lobby with restaurant and an event/conference room that becomes a bar in the evening; premium office above with gym and lounge in the middle.

cards.use: conference by day, event/bar by evening
